onboardingFlow.identityHint: Munhu wese anogamuchirwa. Izvi zvinogadzirisa mashandisiro ako kuti akukodzere.
onboardingFlow.bioHint: Chii chinoita kuti uve wakasiyana? Nharaunda inoda kukuziva.
onboardingFlow.profileHint: Ngatigadzirire mbiri yako kuti vanhu vakuwane.
onboardingFlow.finishHint: Ruzivo rwembiri yako ruchachengetwa kuti upedzise kunyoresa munharaunda.
onboardingFlow.registerHint: Danho rekupedzisira! Nyoresa kuti upinde munharaunda yako.
onboardingFlow.inviteHint: Kunyoresa kunoitwa nekukokwa. Kana wakavhura chinongedzo chekukoka, kodhi inobuda pano. Kana zvisina kudaro, ikumbire kunhengo yakakukoka.
onboardingFlow.name: Zita
onboardingFlow.resumed: Kunyoresa kwatangazve. Pawasvika pachengetwa mubhurawuza iri.
onboardingFlow.notSaved: Hatina kukwanisa kuchengeta pawasvika mubhurawuza iri.
onboardingFlow.missing: Zadza murume kana mukadzi, zuva rekuzvarwa neBanda rako usati waenderera mberi.
onboardingFlow.addressRequired: Simbisa sarudzo yekero kuti uenderere mberi.
onboardingFlow.invalidInvite: Kodhi yekukoka haisiriyo kana kuti haisipo. Itarise woedza zvakare.
onboardingFlow.confirmEmail: Akaundi yagadzirwa! Simbisa imeyili yako wopinda kuti uenderere mberi nekunyoresa. Pawasvika pachengetwa mubhurawuza iri.
onboardingFlow.tourChatHint: Mameseji, odhiyo, mifananidzo nemavhidhiyo kuti muswederane.
onboardingFlow.tourGroupsHint: Gadzira mapoka, ronga zviitiko uye goverana neshamwari.
onboardingFlow.residenceHint: Sarudza kwaunogara, kunyange uri parwendo kana kubasa.
onboardingFlow.atAddress: Wava pakero yaunoda kubatanidza neBanda rako here?
onboardingFlow.locationUnavailable: Nzvimbo haisi kuwanikwa. Unogona kusimbisa gare gare.
onboardingFlow.weakSignal: Chiratidzo hachina simba. Edza zvakare kana kusimbisa gare gare.
onboardingFlow.locationFailed: Hatina kukwanisa kuwana nzvimbo. Unogona kusimbisa gare gare.
onboardingFlow.locationCaptured: Nzvimbo yawanikwa. Kururama kwataurwa nemudziyo: anenge mamita {{accuracy}}. Kusimbiswa kwekugara kuchakamirira.
onboardingFlow.codeHint: Kodhi inoratidza kero. Kodzero yekuishandisa ichaongororwa usati wapiwa chitupa.
onboardingFlow.confirmLaterHint: Unogona kupedzisa kunyoresa uye kutora chikamu. Simbisa kero gare gare paMbiri → Simbisa Banda rangu.
onboardingFlow.residenceNotice: Kuvapo kwako ikozvino hakuratidzi kugara. Mabhenefiti enzvimbo anoda Banda rakasimbiswa; kufamba hakuchinji Banda rako kwega.

calls.addToCallDescription: Nhare mbiri dzemunhu nemunhu dzichapera. Boka idzva richagadzirwa uye vanhu vatatu vose vachakokwa kumusangano wezwi. Munhu mumwe nemumwe anofanira kubvuma. Mameseji nezvakarekodhwa kare hazvizogoverwi.
calls.conferenceInvited: Kukokwa kwatumirwa. Dzvanya Bvuma kuti upinde mumusangano.
calls.waitingDescription: Runhare rwazvino rwunoenderera. Kuti udavire urwu, pedza rwazvino.

academiaPublic.title: Nharaunda dzeAkademi
academiaPublic.heroTitle: Ziva tarenda rako. Ratidza zvaunogona kuita.
academiaPublic.heroBody: Sarudza chikamu, tsvaga basa rekuyedza uye dzidza kubva kune vane ruzivo. Unogona kutanga nezvaunofarira, kugadzirira basa kana kuvandudza bhizinesi rako.
academiaPublic.cohortsBody: Hurongwa hwakafanana kune vose uye kutungamirirwa kwega pamabasa emumwe nemumwe. Kupinda hakubhadharwi; tarisa zvinhu zvinodiwa usati wapinda.
academiaPublic.noCohorts: Hapana makirasi esarudzo iyi parizvino. Unogona kuongorora chimwe chikamu kana kuisa chinangwa chako ndega.
academiaPublic.worksBody: Mabasa akasimbiswa uye akaburitswa nevatori vechikamu vachizvidira.
academiaPublic.languageError: Hatina kukwanisa kushandura mutauro. Edza zvakare.

beleza-moda.title: Runako, fashoni nechitarisiko
beleza-moda.description: Kugera, kugadzira bvudzi, kuruka, makeup, kusona uye kuratidza mabasa aunopa.
beleza-moda.starter_instructions: Gadzirira tsananguro yebasa raunopa uye tsanangura maverengero awakaita mutengo.

cozinha-negocios.title: Kubika nemabhizinesi ezvekudya
cozinha-negocios.description: Kubika, kubheka, kugadzirira chikafu chezviitiko uye mabhizinesi madiki ezvekudya.
cozinha-negocios.starter_instructions: Ratidza chigadzirwa, zvinoshandiswa, mari inodiwa uye mutengo waunoda kutengesa nawo.

criacao-digital.title: Kugadzira nekutaurirana nedhijitari
criacao-digital.description: Kutora mifananidzo, mavhidhiyo, dhizaini, masocial media uye maturusi edhijitari.
criacao-digital.starter_instructions: Gadzira mufananidzo, posita kana vhidhiyo pfupi yekuratidza bhizinesi.

musica-expressao.title: Mimhanzi, kutamba nekuzviratidza
musica-expressao.description: Mimhanzi, kugadzira mimhanzi, DJ, kutamba, kuratidzira uye kuzviratidza neunyanzvi.
musica-expressao.starter_instructions: Ratidza chinhu chawakagadzira kana mutambo uye tsanangura zvaunoda kuvandudza.

oficios-solucoes.title: Mabasa emaoko nemhinduro dzinoshanda
oficios-solucoes.description: Kugadzirisa, kuveza, makanika, simba uye mamwe mabasa emaoko ane kudzidzira kunotungamirirwa.
oficios-solucoes.starter_instructions: Uchitungamirirwa nemurairidzi, tsanangura dambudziko uye gadzirira pfungwa yebasa inoenderana nedanho rako.

emprego-carreira.title: Mabasa nekukura muunyanzvi
emprego-carreira.description: Kugadzirira basa, mitauro, accounting, kufambisa zvinhu uye kusimudzira unyanzvi.
emprego-carreira.starter_instructions: Gadzirisa CV netsananguro yako kuti zvienderane nemukana chaiwo.
